title: The U.N. Scandal Threatening Crucial Aid to Gaza

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin and I'm Mark Ronson and welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰，我是马克·罗森，欢迎收听《重构者》，一档专注于设计之美及其周边文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl,
sentences.zh: 甚至早在黑胶唱片时代我在夜店当DJ的时候，

sentences.en: every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you and you turned a DJ booth into this like living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 每晚你都要带300件你最珍爱的藏品去上班，你把DJ台变成了一个像是由美丽的50年历史老物件组成的活体快闪博物馆。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在即可在你喜爱的播客平台上收听来自阿彼陀的《重构者》。

sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Sabrina Tavernisi and this is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是萨布丽娜·塔维尼西，这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: We turn now to Israel where a growing list of countries around the world have suspended funding to a U.N.
sentences.zh: 我们现在把目光转向以色列，全球越来越多的国家已经暂停了对联合国一个机构的资助。

sentences.en: refugee agency for Palestinians.
sentences.zh: 即联合国巴勒斯坦难民救济和工程处。

sentences.en: Israel has now shared its intelligence claiming at least 13 U.N.
sentences.zh: 以色列现在分享了其情报，声称至少有13名联合国

sentences.en: aid workers actually took part in the Hamas attack on Israel on October 7.
sentences.zh: 人道援助人员实际参与了10月7日哈马斯对以色列的袭击。

sentences.en: Late last month, an explosive allegation that workers from a crucial U.N.
sentences.zh: 上个月末，一个爆炸性的指控震惊了世界，加沙一个至关重要的联合国

sentences.en: relief agency in Gaza had taken part in the October 7 attacks stunned the world and prompted major donors, including the U.S., to suspend funding.
sentences.zh: 救援机构的员工参与了10月7日的袭击，并促使包括美国在内的主要捐助国暂停了资助。

sentences.en: Today, Jerusalem Bureau Chief Patrick Kingsley on what this could mean for the humanitarian crisis in Gaza and how it might complicate Israel's strategy in the war.
sentences.zh: 今天，耶路撒冷分社社长帕特里克·金斯利将探讨这对加沙的人道主义危机意味着什么，以及它将如何使以色列在战争中的战略复杂化。

sentences.en: It's Tuesday, February 6th.
sentences.zh: 今天是2月6日，星期二。

sentences.en: Patrick, hi.
sentences.zh: 帕特里克，你好。

sentences.en: Hi, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 你好，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: So the last time we talked, late last year, there was this growing humanitarian crisis in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 所以我们上次谈话是在去年年底，当时加沙正面临日益严重的人道主义危机。

sentences.en: Most of the population had been displaced.
sentences.zh: 大部分人口流离失所。

sentences.en: Disease and hunger were starting to emerge as bigger and bigger probleMs.
sentences.zh: 疾病和饥饿开始成为越来越严重的问题。

sentences.en: Now the situation has gotten worse.
sentences.zh: 现在情况变得更糟了。

sentences.en: And in the midst of all of this, the main U.N.
sentences.zh: 正是在这一切之中，联合国的主要

sentences.en: relief agency in Gaza, known as UNRWA, has been engulfed in scandal over accusations that some of its staff actually played a role in the October 7th attack.
sentences.zh: 加沙救援机构，即近东救济工程处，因指控其部分员工确实在10月7日的袭击中扮演了角色而陷入丑闻。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So tell me the story and what we know.
sentences.zh: 那么请告诉我事情的经过以及我们所知道的情况。

sentences.en: What we know is this.
sentences.zh: 我们所知道的是这样的。

sentences.en: On January 18th, the head of UMRA, Philippe Bazzarini, went to what was expected to be a routine meeting with a senior Israeli diplomat
sentences.zh: 1月18日，近东救济工程处的负责人菲利普·拉扎里尼去参加了一场本应是例行的会议，对象是一位以色列高级外交官，

sentences.en: to discuss delivery of aid and fuel to Gaza, the supplies that UMRA helps to coordinate.
sentences.zh: 讨论向加沙运送援助物资和燃料，即近东救济工程处协助协调的物资。

sentences.en: Instead, the Israeli diplomat dropped a bombshell accusation.
sentences.zh: 相反，这位以色列外交官投下了一个重磅炸弹般的指控。

sentences.en: He claimed that roughly a dozen employees of UMRA had either participated in the Hamas-led raid on Israel on October 7th, or, in one case, in its aftermath.
sentences.zh: 他声称近东救济工程处大约有十多名员工要么参与了10月7日哈马斯主导的对以色列的突袭，或者在其中一个案例中，参与了其后续事件。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So that is quite a bombshell.
sentences.zh: 所以这确实是个重磅炸弹。

sentences.en: It's a very serious allegation.
sentences.zh: 这是一个非常严重的指控。

sentences.en: This is just a small, tiny minority of the 13,000 employees of UMRA in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 这只是近东救济工程处在加沙的13000名员工中的一小部分。

sentences.en: But nevertheless, it's too many.
sentences.zh: 但尽管如此，人数还是太多了。

sentences.en: And certainly not what you expect of a U.N.
sentences.zh: 而且这绝对不是你对一个致力于中立和人道主义的联合国

sentences.en: agency that is devoted to neutrality and humanitarianism.
sentences.zh: 机构所期望的。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So actually, tell us what this agency does in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 那么，请告诉我们这个机构在加沙做些什么。

sentences.en: UMRA is the main aid organization for Palestinians that is run by the United Nations.
sentences.zh: 近东救济工程处是联合国运营的针对巴勒斯坦人的主要援助组织。

sentences.en: In times outside war, it provides education and primary health care for roughly 5 million Palestinians across the Middle East, including more than a million in Gaza itself.
sentences.zh: 在非战争时期，它为中东各地的约500万巴勒斯坦人提供教育和初级医疗保健，其中包括加沙本地的一百多万人。

sentences.en: It runs hundreds of schools and provides education for roughly 300,000 guys and children.
sentences.zh: 它运营着数百所学校，为大约30万加沙儿童提供教育。

sentences.en: Since the war has begun, it has been the primary supplier of shelter to displaced Palestinians.
sentences.zh: 自战争爆发以来，它一直是流离失所的巴勒斯坦人的主要庇护所供应商。

sentences.en: More than half the population is now living in an UMRA facility.
sentences.zh: 目前一半以上的人口都住在近东救济工程处的设施里。

sentences.en: Its schools and other facilities have provided a roof over the head of some 1.2 million guards since the start of the war.
sentences.zh: 自战争爆发以来，其学校和其他设施为大约120万加沙人提供了栖身之所。

sentences.en: A crucial organization, especially in this moment.
sentences.zh: 这是一个至关重要的组织，尤其是在此时此地。

sentences.en: Yes, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对如此。

sentences.en: And after that meeting with the senior Israeli diplomat,
sentences.zh: 在与以色列高级外交官的那次会面之后，

sentences.en: Lazzarini, the head of UMRA, begins to fire nine of the employees who are accused of participating in the attack.
sentences.zh: 近东救济工程处负责人拉扎里尼开始解雇九名被指控参与袭击的员工。

sentences.en: Two of them, we believe, are already dead, and at least one of them in the attack itself.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，其中两人已经身亡，其中至少一人死于袭击本身。

sentences.en: Then the UN starts to tell the donor states that provide UMRA with most of its funding, chief among them, the United States.
sentences.zh: 然后联合国开始通知向近东救济工程处提供大部分资金的捐助国，其中最主要的美国。

sentences.en: And that led to senior American diplomats being briefed on the claims, and they were presented by Israeli officials with a dossier outlining these claiMs.
sentences.zh: 这导致美国高级外交官听取了有关这些指控的简报，以色列官员向他们提交了一份概述这些指控的档案。

sentences.en: On that same day, UMRA decided to announce to the world that these allegations had been made against some of their employees and that some of them had already been fired.
sentences.zh: 就在同一天，近东救济工程处决定向全世界宣布，有人对他们的一些员工提出了这些指控，并且其中一些人已经被解雇。

sentences.en: Now, the UN has fired nine UNRWA members.
sentences.zh: 现在，联合国已经解雇了九名近东救济工程处成员。

sentences.en: We understand two more are being looked into.
sentences.zh: 据我们了解，另外两人正在接受调查。

sentences.en: And that news led the United States and then a cascade of more than a dozen other countries to suspend their funding for UMRA, pending further investigation.
sentences.zh: 这一消息导致美国以及随后十几个国家的连串反应，暂停了对近东救济工程处的资助，等待进一步调查。

sentences.en: The US has paused funding to the UN agency that is actually providing aid to the Palestinians.
sentences.zh: 美国已暂停向这个实际在向巴勒斯坦人提供援助的联合国机构提供资金。

sentences.en: Canada announced it too has temporarily paused any additional...
sentences.zh: 加拿大宣布它也暂时暂停了任何额外的……

sentences.en: The latest to hold aid being Germany.
sentences.zh: 最新暂停援助的是德国。

sentences.en: Japan and Austria became the latest countries to suspend payments.
sentences.zh: 日本和奥地利成为最新暂停付款的国家。

sentences.en: And this came on the same day...
sentences.zh: 而这发生在同一天……

sentences.en: ...hours after the UN's top court ordered Israel to take measures to prevent acts of genocide in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 在联合国最高法院下令以色列采取措施防止加沙发生灭绝种族行为几小时后……

sentences.en: ...that the International Court of Justice in The Hague had ruled that in order to prevent genocide, Israel needed to supply more aid to Gaza.
sentences.zh: 位于海牙的国际法院裁定，为了防止灭绝种族，以色列需要向加沙提供更多援助。

sentences.en: And so at a time when more aid was supposed to be coming in to Gaza, the UN's biggest aid agency was running the risk of collapse.
sentences.zh: 因此，正当更多援助应该涌入加沙之际，联合国最大的援助机构却面临着崩溃的风险。

sentences.en: The head of UNRWA is calling for all those nations who are suspending funding right now to change their minds.
sentences.zh: 近东救济工程处负责人呼吁所有目前暂停资助的国家改变主意。

sentences.en: Given the desperate plight of so many, this would be a heavy blow if UNRWA's operations were suspended in some way.
sentences.zh: 鉴于许多人绝望的困境，如果近东救济工程处的运作以某种方式被暂停，这将是一个沉重的打击。

sentences.en: And indeed, we've been told by UNRWA's leadership that if the funds aren't restored by the end of February, it will struggle to operate.
sentences.zh: 事实上，近东救济工程处领导层已经告诉我们，如果资金在2月底前未能恢复，其运作将举步维艰。

sentences.en: That could have grave implications for the distribution of aid and the provision of shelter to more than a million Gazans just at the wrong time.
sentences.zh: 这可能会对加沙一百多万人的援助分发和住所提供产生严重影响，而时机偏偏选在最糟糕的时候。

sentences.en: Just as we're told that famine is looming in parts of Gaza,
sentences.zh: 正如我们所被告知的那样，加沙部分地区正面临饥荒的阴影，

sentences.en: more than half the buildings in Gaza are damaged or destroyed, according to UN estimates.
sentences.zh: 根据联合国的估计，加沙超过一半的建筑受损或被毁。

sentences.en: And around 2 million people out of 2.2 million have been displaced.
sentences.zh: 在220万人口中，大约有200万人流离失所。

sentences.en: So it couldn't be happening, this convergence of events at a worse time.
sentences.zh: 因此，这一系列事件的汇聚不可能发生在更糟糕的时刻了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: An already bad situation is likely to get a lot worse for Gazans.
sentences.zh: 对于加沙人来说，本已糟糕的局势可能会变得更加恶化。

sentences.en: Yes, exactly.
sentences.zh: 是的，完全正确。

sentences.en: What were the actual charges, Patrick?
sentences.zh: 帕特里克，具体的指控是什么？

sentences.en: I mean, what did you learn about that?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你对此了解到了什么？

sentences.en: Well, to begin with, it really wasn't clear what the specific allegations were.
sentences.zh: 嗯，首先，具体的指控到底是什么并不十分清楚。

sentences.en: We had this statement from UMRA saying that there were claims against various employees.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了近东救济工程处的声明，称有针对多名员工的指控。

sentences.en: There was talk of a dossier, but no one was releasing any information.
sentences.zh: 有关于一份档案的传言，但没有人公布任何信息。

sentences.en: So what me and our colleague Renan Bergman did, we spent the weekend calling up as many sources as we could reach, trying to find out exactly what this dossier had said.
sentences.zh: 所以我和我们的同事罗南·伯格曼花了整个周末打电话联系我们能找到的所有消息来源，试图弄清楚这份档案到底说了什么。

sentences.en: And two days after the allegations broke, we finally got our hands on the dossier itself.
sentences.zh: 就在指控爆发两天后，我们终于拿到了这份档案本身。

sentences.en: And what it alleged was shocking.
sentences.zh: 而它所指控的内容令人震惊。

sentences.en: It said that, for example, one of the employees, a teacher, had been involved in a raid on the Israeli village of Be'eri,
sentences.zh: 它说，例如，其中一名员工，一名教师，曾参与对以色列村庄贝埃里的袭击，

sentences.en: where roughly 100 people were killed during the October 7th attack.
sentences.zh: 在10月7日的袭击中，该村大约有100人丧生。

sentences.en: It said another person was involved in the kidnapping of a woman.
sentences.zh: 它说另一个人参与了一名女性的绑架。

sentences.en: It said that a third person was involved in the capture of a soldier's corpse on October 7th.
sentences.zh: 它说第三个人参与了10月7日夺取一名士兵尸体的行动。

sentences.en: And so on and so on.
sentences.zh: 诸如此类，不一而足。

sentences.en: The list went on.
sentences.zh: 名单还在继续。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哈。

sentences.en: The dossier said the information was mainly taken from wiretaps of people's phones and also through the geolocation of people's phones on the day of October 7th.
sentences.zh: 档案称，这些信息主要取自人们的电话窃听，以及通过10月7日当天人们手机的地理定位获取的。

sentences.en: We could only confirm the identity of one of the people accused, but we had no way of verifying the material ourselves.
sentences.zh: 我们只能确认其中一名被指控者的身份，但我们自己无法核实这些材料。

sentences.en: All we knew was that Umbra had decided themselves to take action, both firing nine people and announcing the news publicly.
sentences.zh: 我们所知道的是，近东救济工程处决定自行采取行动，既解雇了九人，又公开宣布了这一消息。

sentences.en: And that wasn't all.
sentences.zh: 而且还不止于此。

sentences.en: The dossier also had another claim, an even bigger claim, that had not previously been reported.
sentences.zh: 该档案还有另一个说法，一个更大、以前未曾报道过的说法。

sentences.en: And that was that according to the Israeli military, roughly a tenth of Umrah's staff of 13,000 inside Gaza were affiliated or members of Hamas and other militant factions.
sentences.zh: 那就是根据以色列军方的说法，近东救济工程处在加沙内部的13000名员工中，大约十分之一与哈马斯及其他激进派别有联系或本身就是其成员。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And this was an astonishing claim for an agency that is supposed to be neutral, supposed to be independent of political groups, let alone armed groups.
sentences.zh: 对于一个本应中立、本应独立于政治集团更不用说武装集团的机构来说，这是一个惊人的说法。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And once again, this was an impossible to verify claim, and the Israelis have not publicly produced any evidence to support it.
sentences.zh: 再次强调，这是一个无法核实的说法，以色列人也没有公开出示任何证据来支持它。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, they say that this calculation is taken by cross-referencing a list of Umrah staff members in Gaza with lists or a list of Hamas members
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，他们表示，这一计算是通过将加沙的近东救济工程处员工名单与以色列军方在入侵加沙期间

sentences.en: that the Israeli military had taken during its invasion of Gaza from computers that they found in Hamas bases inside the territory.
sentences.zh: 从该领土内哈马斯基地发现的电脑中获取的哈马斯成员名单进行交叉比对得出的。

sentences.en: But Patrick, what exactly does Israel mean when it says 10% of the staff, some 1,300 people, were considered members of Hamas?
sentences.zh: 但是帕特里克，当以色列说10%的员工，即大约1300人被认为是哈马斯成员时，这到底是什么意思？

sentences.en: Like, are we talking about militants?
sentences.zh: 比如说，我们是在谈论武装分子吗？

sentences.en: Are we talking about government bureaucrats?
sentences.zh: 我们是在谈论政府官僚吗？

sentences.en: Because, of course, Hamas is the government of Gaza.
sentences.zh: 因为，当然，哈马斯是加沙的政府。

sentences.en: The claim was that roughly 200 of those 1,300 were involved in militant activities.
sentences.zh: 据称，在那1300人中，大约有200人参与了武装活动。

sentences.en: The rest of the 1,300, so the vast majority, were people involved in the political movement or the social movement of Hamas.
sentences.zh: 其余的1300人，也就是绝大多数人，是参与哈马斯政治运动或社会运动的人。

sentences.en: Remember that Hamas is not just an armed faction that fires rockets at Israel or that attacked Israel on October 7th.
sentences.zh: 记住，哈马斯不仅是一个向以色列发射火箭弹或在10月7日袭击以色列的武装派别。

sentences.en: It's also a social movement that has deep roots in society and helps to run a civilian government.
sentences.zh: 它也是一个在社会上有深厚根基并帮助运营平民政府的社会运动。

sentences.en: And there is quite a lot of overlap between its membership and the general population of Gaza, which is not to say that the majority of Gazans are affiliated with Hamas,
sentences.zh: 其成员身份与加沙普通民众之间存在相当多的重叠，这并不是说大多数加沙人都与哈马斯有联系，

sentences.en: but just to say that, in a way, it's not that surprising that any large institution in Gaza would have some level of overlap
sentences.zh: 而只是说，在某种程度上，加沙的任何大型机构在某种程度上与像哈马斯这样庞大的政治运动和社会运动产生重叠，并不是那么令人惊奇的事。

sentences.en: with a political movement and a social movement as large as Hamas.
sentences.zh: 近东救济工程处在加沙的员工主要从加沙人口中招募。

sentences.en: AMRA takes its staff predominantly in Gaza from the population of Gaza.
sentences.zh: 这13000名近东救济工程处员工大多不是来自其他国家的国际援助人员。

sentences.en: The 13,000 AMRA staff members are mostly not international aid workers from other countries.
sentences.zh: 他们来自他们工作的那个地方，加沙。

sentences.en: They come from the place that they are working in, Gaza.
sentences.zh: 事实上，如果你去世界任何地方，任何有经验的援助人员都会告诉你，与任何武装集团或叛乱组织保持独立一直是一个持续的挑战，

sentences.en: And indeed, if you go anywhere in the world, any experienced aid worker will tell you that it's a constant challenge to maintain independence from any armed group or rebel group,
sentences.zh: 无论是在南苏丹还是在斯里兰卡北部。

sentences.en: be it in South Sudan or northern Sri Lanka.
sentences.zh: 这些是影响援助部门及其工作地点的普遍挑战。

sentences.en: And these are common challenges that affect the aid sector or wherever they work.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，联合国本应是一个政治中立的机构。

sentences.en: All that said, the UN is supposed to be a politically neutral body.
sentences.zh: 正是这一点赋予了联合国其威严和力量。

sentences.en: And that's what gives the UN its gravitas and its power.
sentences.zh: 然而，这是一个旨在凌驾于政治之上、凌驾于分歧之上的机构，它本不应该被冲突的任何一方所妥协。

sentences.en: However, this is an institution that's meant to be above politics, above division, and it's not supposed to be compromised by any party to a conflict.
sentences.zh: 因此，它的员工不应该是哈马斯或任何其他巴勒斯坦政治武装集团的成员。

sentences.en: So its workers should not be members of Hamas or any other Palestinian political armed group, for that matter.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 如果属实，这一说法将是极具毁灭性的。

sentences.en: If it's true, this claim would be hugely damning.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 一旦这些信息，即10%的数字，引起了更广泛世界的注意，

sentences.en: And once this information, this 10% figure, was brought to the attention of the wider world,
sentences.zh: 它在近东救济工程处批评者的眼中巩固了这样一种观点：近东救济工程处内部已经腐烂。

sentences.en: it cemented in the eyes of UNRWA's critics the idea that something was rotten within UNRWA.
sentences.zh: 随着更多国家暂停资助，这种情况随之发生。

sentences.en: And that came as more countries suspended their funding.
sentences.zh: 并且在几天后导致了……

sentences.en: And it led, a couple of days later...
sentences.zh: 我认为国际社会和联合国本身是时候认识到近东救济工程处的使命必须结束了。

sentences.en: And I think it's time that the international community and the UN itself understand that UNRWA's mission has to end.
sentences.zh: 对于本雅明·内塔尼亚胡来说，自指控发出以来尚属首次……

sentences.en: To Benjamin Netanyahu, for the first time since the allegations were made...
sentences.zh: 联合国还有其他机构，世界上还有其他机构，它们必须取代近东救济工程处。

sentences.en: There are other agencies in the UN, there are other agencies in the world, they have to replace UNRWA.
sentences.zh: 明确呼吁解散近东救济工程处。

sentences.en: Calling specifically for Umrah's dissolution.
sentences.zh: 哈马斯对此有何说法（如果有的话）？

sentences.en: What, if anything, has Hamas said about this?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们是证实还是否认这些人实际上是哈马斯成员？

sentences.en: I mean, do they confirm or deny that these folks are, in fact, members of Hamas?
sentences.zh: 所以我向哈马斯的人提出了这个问题，但没有得到明确的回答。

sentences.en: So I asked the Hamas folks that question and didn't get a clear answer.
sentences.zh: 他们公开表示的是，他们谴责近东救济工程处批评任何参与他们视为对以色列的正当抵抗的人的行动，

sentences.en: What they have publicly said is that they condemn UNRWA for criticizing the actions of anyone who has participated in what they see as legitimate resistance against Israel,
sentences.zh: 而这被世界大部分地区视为残酷的恐怖主义行为。

sentences.en: but what much of the world sees as acts of brutal terrorism.
sentences.zh: 他们还批评近东救济工程处根据哈马斯的敌人以色列提供的材料解雇其部分员工。

sentences.en: And they also criticized UNRWA for firing some of its employees based on material given to it by Hamas's enemy, Israel.
sentences.zh: 所以，帕特里克，近东救济工程处与哈马斯之间的这种关系非常紧张。

sentences.en: So, Patrick, this relationship between UNRWA and Hamas is very fraught.
sentences.zh: 近东救济工程处负责加沙的关键服务，你知道的，为该国很大一部分人口提供社会安全网，那是在正常时期，

sentences.en: UNRWA is responsible for critical services in Gaza, you know, social safety net for a big swath of the country, and that's in normal times,
sentences.zh: 并且必须应对与被美国、欧盟及其他各方视为恐怖组织的执政者哈马斯并肩工作的局面。

sentences.en: and has to navigate working side by side with the government, which is Hamas, which is considered a terrorist group by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 现在，在战争期间，近东救济工程处对试图在哈马斯10月7日袭击以色列之后的轰炸和入侵中生存下来的加沙人民来说更加至关重要。

sentences.en: and the EU and others.
sentences.zh: 但近东救济工程处现在也面临着因拥有与该袭击相关的员工而受到的审查。

sentences.en: And now, in the midst of the war, UNRWA is even more critical to the people of Gaza, who are trying to survive the bombardments and the invasion
sentences.zh: 所以这一切都非常复杂。

sentences.en: following Hamas's October 7th attack on Israel.
sentences.zh: 极其复杂。

sentences.en: But UNRWA is also now facing the scrutiny for having staff associated with that attack.
sentences.zh: 近东救济工程处独立于哈马斯。

sentences.en: So that's all very complicated.
sentences.zh: 它在形式上与该组织没有任何关系，但它仍然在一个以哈马斯为统治者的独裁政权内部运作。

sentences.en: It's hugely complicated.
sentences.zh: 这迫使它不得不与哈马斯并肩工作。

sentences.en: UNRWA is independent of Hamas.
sentences.zh: 嗯，对。

sentences.en: It's got formally nothing to do with the group, but it nevertheless operates within a dictatorial regime, in which Hamas is the ruler.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: And that forces it to work side by side with Hamas.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And at the same time, they also have to coordinate with the Israeli armed forces in order to ensure that aid and other supplies
sentences.zh: 与此同时，他们还必须与以色列武装部队进行协调，以确保援助物资和其他供应品

sentences.en: and also their own international employees can enter and exit Gaza.
sentences.zh: 以及他们自己的国际员工能够进出加沙。

sentences.en: So this has all been very difficult to navigate for years.
sentences.zh: 因此，多年来，这一切在应对上都非常困难。

sentences.en: During the 2021 war with Israel, for example, or just after it, the most senior UMRA official in Gaza made comments that were perceived to be favorable
sentences.zh: 例如，在2021年与以色列的战争期间，或者就在战争刚结束之后，近东救济工程处在加沙最高级别的官员发表了一些被认为倾向于

sentences.en: towards Israel's military operations.
sentences.zh: 以色列军事行动的言论。

sentences.en: And there was such an outcry in Gaza and from Hamas because of that, that this official was withdrawn from UMRA.
sentences.zh: 正因为如此，加沙和哈马斯爆发了强烈的抗议，导致该官员被近东救济工程处撤职。

sentences.en: But from the Israeli perspective, this kind of tension between UMRA and Hamas is a fig leaf that obscures a more symbiotic relationship
sentences.zh: 但在以色列看来，近东救济工程处与哈马斯之间的这种紧张关系只是一块遮羞布，掩盖了一种更为共生的关系

sentences.en: in which UMRA is not fully independent and operates, in their view, under Hamas's influence.
sentences.zh: 即近东救济工程处并非完全独立，在他们看来，该机构是在哈马斯的影响下运作的。

sentences.en: UMRA denies that completely and says that it's totally neutral.
sentences.zh: 近东救济工程处对此完全予以否认，并坚称自己是绝对中立的。

sentences.en: But nevertheless, the accusation has long been that UMRA works under the influence of Hamas.
sentences.zh: 然而，长期以来的指责一直是近东救济工程处在哈马斯的影响下运作。

sentences.en: So in a way, this latest incident is just one in a long line of flashpoints between UMRA and Israel that goes back decades.
sentences.zh: 所以在某种程度上，这起最新事件只是近东救济工程处与以色列之间长达数十年的众多冲突点之一。

sentences.en: If for Palestinians, UMRA is an icon and something of a protector,
sentences.zh: 如果说对于巴勒斯坦人而言，近东救济工程处是一个象征，也是某种程度上的保护者，

sentences.en: to many Israelis, it's a consistent problem.
sentences.zh: 那么对于许多以色列人来说，它一直是一个棘手的问题。

sentences.en: And this latest incident simply confirmed perceptions that Israelis have long held about the group.
sentences.zh: 而这起最新事件仅仅证实了以色列人长期以来对该组织的看法。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: 33 presidents.
sentences.zh: 33位总统。

sentences.en: I called the president at 4.30 in the morning and he answered.
sentences.zh: 我在凌晨4点30分给总统打了电话，他接了。

sentences.en: Seven decades in space.
sentences.zh: 太空七十年。

sentences.en: We want to see what's beyond the next star.
sentences.zh: 我们想要探索下一颗星星之外的世界。

sentences.en: A thousand consumer product guides.
sentences.zh: 上千份消费品指南。

sentences.en: Today, I am testing seven mattresses.
sentences.zh: 今天，我正在测试七款床垫。

sentences.en: 60 super sundaes.
sentences.zh: 60款超级圣代。

sentences.en: They were probably the best team in the league every single year.
sentences.zh: 他们可能是每年联盟里最好的球队。

sentences.en: 53,500 puzzles.
I use a different starting word every day.
sentences.zh: 我每天都使用不同的起始单词。

sentences.en: 25,000 recipes.
And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 而且我喜欢一锅端食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》庆祝成立175周年，助您理解世界，过好每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即访问 nytimes.com/subscribe 订阅以获取特惠。

sentences.en: So, Patrick, you said that many in Israel have long believed that UMRA is a consistent problem.
sentences.zh: 那么，帕特里克，你提到以色列有许多人长期以来一直认为近东救济工程处是一个持续存在的问题。

sentences.en: What do you mean by that?
sentences.zh: 你这话是什么意思？

sentences.en: What I mean is they take issue with what they say that the agency fundamentally stands for.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们对该机构从根本上所代表的立场提出了质疑。

sentences.en: And that goes all the way back to the reasons why it was founded in 1949, a year after Israel was founded.
sentences.zh: 这可以追溯到该机构于1949年（即以色列建国一年后）成立的原因。

sentences.en: At that time, you had roughly or more than 700,000 Palestinian refugees who had fled or been forced from their homes
sentences.zh: 当时，大约有或超过70万巴勒斯坦难民在

sentences.en: during the wars that surrounded the creation of the state of Israel.
sentences.zh: 围绕以色列国建立的战争期间逃离或被迫离开家园。

sentences.en: And to care for those refugees who had been scattered all across the Middle East, in Lebanon, in Jordan, and in Gaza, the UN founded one of the first UN agencies in its history.
sentences.zh: 为了照顾这些散落在整个中东地区（黎巴嫩、约旦和加沙）的难民，联合国创立了其历史上最早的联合国机构之一。

sentences.en: It was called the UN Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees, or UNRWA for short.
sentences.zh: 它被称为联合国近东巴勒斯坦难民救济和工程处，简称近东救济工程处。

sentences.en: And its job was to provide education and other services to those refugees.
sentences.zh: 其职责是为这些难民提供教育和其他服务。

sentences.en: And for the 74 years since, it has basically acted, implicitly, if not directly, to maintain the identity of those Palestinian refugees.
sentences.zh: 在随后的74年里，它基本上一直在发挥作用（即使不是直接的，也是含蓄地），以维持这些巴勒斯坦难民的身份认同。

sentences.en: And to, in the Israeli view, sustain the idea in those refugees' minds that one day, because they're refugees, they might actually return to the place that they were forced from.
sentences.zh: 并且在以色列看来，它在这些难民的心中维持着这样一种观念：总有一天，由于他们是难民，他们实际上可能会返回他们被迫离开的地方。

sentences.en: And they might one day come back, live in the homes that their families lived in, in what became Israel.
sentences.zh: 他们可能有一天会回来，住在他们的家人曾经生活在现已成为以色列领土上的房屋里。

sentences.en: But to Israelis, that is an enormously threatening idea, because if you had 5 million Palestinians returning to Israel, as these refugees and their descendants now number,
sentences.zh: 但在以色列人看来，这是一个极具威胁性的想法，因为如果像这些难民及其后代现在这样有500万巴勒斯坦人返回以色列，

sentences.en: it would completely dilute the Jewish character of the Jewish state, and Israelis don't want that.
sentences.zh: 这将彻底冲淡犹太国家的犹太特质，以色列人是不希望看到这一点的。

sentences.en: To Israelis, it's also threatening, because the idea of 5 million people coming from territory where Israel has fought many wars for decades with is a security threat.
sentences.zh: 对以色列人来说，这也是一种威胁，因为500万人从一个以色列数十年来与之进行过多场战争的领土涌入，这一想法构成了安全威胁。

sentences.en: It's also a logistical threat.
sentences.zh: 这也是一个后勤威胁。

sentences.en: How would it work if 5 million people, or even a small minority, come to Israel and try to move into the villages where they once lived, many of which were destroyed?
sentences.zh: 如果500万人，哪怕只是一小部分人来到以色列，并试图搬进他们曾经居住过的村庄（其中许多村庄已被摧毁），这该如何运作？

sentences.en: Then there's another perspective, which more or less acknowledges all the criticisms that Israel makes about the very character of the institution of Umbra.
sentences.zh: 然后还有另一种观点，它或多或少承认了以色列对近东救济工程处这一机构本质的所有批评。

sentences.en: But in the Palestinian perspective, this is a good thing.
sentences.zh: 但在巴勒斯坦人的视角中，这是一件好事。

sentences.en: While many people who are classified today as Palestinian refugees were not alive in 1948, they nevertheless feel that it is their right
sentences.zh: 虽然今天被归类为巴勒斯坦难民的许多人在1948年时尚未出生，但他们依然认为自己有权

sentences.en: to return to land on which their ancestors lived on many years previously.
sentences.zh: 返回他们祖辈许多年前曾居住过的土地。

sentences.en: So, in a sense, there's quite a lot of common ground between the Israeli and Palestinian perspective of Umbra.
sentences.zh: 因此，从某种意义上说，以色列和巴勒斯坦对近东救济工程处的看法有着相当多的共识。

sentences.en: One side just thinks its existence is a bad thing, and the other thinks it's a good thing.
sentences.zh: 一方只是认为它的存在是一件坏事，而另一方则认为这是一件好事。

sentences.en: So I guess I get how this agency could symbolically represent a threat to Israel.
sentences.zh: 所以我想我能理解这个机构如何在象征意义上对以色列构成威胁。

sentences.en: But in reality, how much is this aid organization actually a threat to the state of Israel?
sentences.zh: 但在现实中，这个援助组织对以色列国到底构成了多大程度的威胁？

sentences.en: I mean, how much are they actually working toward Palestinians getting to return to what is now Israel?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们实际上在多大程度上致力于让巴勒斯坦人重返现在的以色列？

sentences.en: Well, the claim is not that the leaders of Umbra are going around directly mobilizing Palestinian refugees to return to Israel.
sentences.zh: 嗯，各方的说法并不是说近东救济工程处的领导层在四处直接动员巴勒斯坦难民返回以色列。

sentences.en: A lot of the debate around Umbra centers on what is taught in its schools.
sentences.zh: 围绕近东救济工程处的许多争论集中在其学校教授的内容上。

sentences.en: In Israel, it has not gone unnoticed that of the dozen people accused of participating in the October 7th attack, several of them were either teachers or workers in those schools.
sentences.zh: 在以色列，人们并没有忽视这样一个事实：在被指控参与10月7日袭击的十几人中，有好几人是这些学校的老师或工作人员。

sentences.en: And the curriculums in those schools have also come under tremendous Israeli scrutiny.
sentences.zh: 这些学校的课程也受到了以色列极其严格的审查。

sentences.en: In one case, researchers highlighted how a textbook glorified a Palestinian militant who was involved in a terror attack on Israeli civilians in the 1970s called Dalal Maghrabi.
sentences.zh: 在一个案例中，研究人员强调了一本教科书如何美化了一名参与1970年代针对以色列平民恐怖袭击的巴勒斯坦武装分子达拉尔·马格拉比（Dalal Maghrabi）。

sentences.en: And in other cases, Israeli researchers have highlighted maps of Palestine published in textbooks used in Umbra schools that do not include the state of Israel.
sentences.zh: 在其他案例中，以色列研究人员强调了近东救济工程处学校所使用的教科书中发布的巴勒斯坦地图并未将以色列国包含在内。

sentences.en: Umbra has, in some cases, acknowledged these criticisms, and has said it's taken action to withdraw those particular materials from circulation.
sentences.zh: 近东救济工程处在某些情况下承认了这些批评，并表示已采取行动将这些特定材料从流通中撤出。

sentences.en: And Palestinians, for their part, also make similar criticisms of the Israeli education system, where you often see maps of Israel that don't include the West Bank or Gaza
sentences.zh: 而巴勒斯坦人也对以色列的教育系统提出了类似的批评，在那里你经常能看到不包括约旦河西岸或加沙的以色列地图

sentences.en: or assume that the West Bank is part of the state of Israel.
sentences.zh: 或者默认约旦河西岸是以色列国的一部分。

sentences.en: And Palestinians in general point out that the education system that is provided in Amra schools
sentences.zh: 巴勒斯坦人普遍指出，近东救济工程处学校提供的教育系统

sentences.en: and in other parts of the Palestinian education system is of a fairly good standard,
sentences.zh: 以及巴勒斯坦教育系统的其他部分保持着相当不错的标准，

sentences.en: the literacy rate among Palestinians stands at 95%, which is nearly 10 points higher than the global average.
sentences.zh: 巴勒斯坦人的识字率高达95%，比全球平均水平高出近10个百分点。

sentences.en: The other major criticism that Israelis make about Amra is that it somehow turns a blind eye to Hamas's militant activity,
sentences.zh: 以色列对近东救济工程处的另一项主要批评是，它在某种程度上对哈马斯的武装活动视而不见，

sentences.en: that Hamas or other militant groups have stored ammunition inside Amra facilities or have fired rockets from very close to Amra schools
sentences.zh: 即哈马斯或其他武装组织在近东救济工程处的设施内存放弹药，或者在距离近东救济工程处学校非常近的地方发射火箭弹

sentences.en: or even dug tunnels underneath its buildings.
sentences.zh: 甚至在其建筑物下方挖掘地道。

sentences.en: And Amra says that when it finds out about this, it takes action and has even publicized some of these transgressions itself.
sentences.zh: 而近东救济工程处表示，当它发现这种情况时，它会采取行动，甚至自己公开了一些此类违规行为。

sentences.en: And ultimately, it can't do much if people fire rockets from close to its schools.
sentences.zh: 归根结底，如果有人在其学校附近发射火箭弹，它也做不了太多事情。

sentences.en: It's not an armed institution and has no means of combating that.
sentences.zh: 它不是一个武装机构，也没有手段来打击这种行为。

sentences.en: So for the critics of Amra, the idea is basically that Amra is supporting the Hamas agenda, which is, of course, the destruction of Israel,
sentences.zh: 因此，对于近东救济工程处的批评者来说，其核心观点基本上是近东救济工程处在支持哈马斯的议程（当然，该议程就是消灭以色列），

sentences.en: through propaganda and then looking the other way when Hamas uses their facilities for war.
sentences.zh: 方法是通过宣传，然后在哈马斯利用其设施进行战争时睁一只眼闭一只眼。

sentences.en: But Amra is saying, we don't have a military to stop any of this stuff.
sentences.zh: 但近东救济工程处则表示，我们没有军队来阻止任何这些事情。

sentences.en: We're just trying to provide services the best we can in an extremely difficult environment.
sentences.zh: 我们只是在极其艰难的环境中尽最大努力提供服务。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: And that's why an allegation like the ones we've been hearing in recent days have been so damaging because it suggests that Amra isn't just an independent institution
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么像我们最近几天听到这样的指控会如此具有破坏性，因为这表明近东救济工程处不仅仅是一个在艰难环境中工作的独立机构，

sentences.en: working within a difficult environment, but that it has been infiltrated by people who are members of the group that the UN is saying it's independent from.
sentences.zh: 而是已经被那些联合宣称与其保持独立的组织成员所渗透。

sentences.en: So I have to imagine that people who've been making these accusations all of these years are feeling pretty satisfied that these allegations have come to light
sentences.zh: 所以我不得不想象，多年来一直提出这些指控的人现在会感到相当满意，因为这些指控终于大白于天下

sentences.en: and are being seen by the world and taken seriously by the world.
sentences.zh: 并被世界所看到，受到世界的严肃对待。

sentences.en: I think yes and no.
sentences.zh: 我认为可以说是，也可以说不是。

sentences.en: Some people are delighted.
sentences.zh: 有些人欣喜若狂。

sentences.en: They're saying, we've always said this, and finally, these ideas are getting prime time.
sentences.zh: 他们说，我们一直这么说，终于这些观点得到了黄金时段的关注。

sentences.en: Others may agree fundamentally that Amra is this nefarious organization, but they don't feel this is the time to try and bring it down
sentences.zh: 其他人可能根本上同意近东救济工程处是一个邪恶的组织，但他们觉得现在不是试图将其瓦解的时候，

sentences.en: because as much as they dislike the premise of what Amra stands for, they recognize that it plays a huge and important role in sustaining life,
sentences.zh: 因为尽管他们不喜欢近东救济工程处所代表的前提，但他们认识到它在维持生命方面发挥着巨大而重要的作用，

sentences.en: ultimately, during a devastating war that has killed roughly one in a hundred Gazans, according to Gazan official estimates.
sentences.zh: 特别是在这场毁灭性的战争期间——根据加沙官方估计，这场战争已经夺走了大约百分之一加沙人的生命。

sentences.en: And they don't have a plan for what could replace Amra and who could step in, who has the manpower and the logistical footprint to deliver aid, to provide shelter.
sentences.zh: 而且他们对于什么可以取代近东救济工程处、谁能介入、谁拥有提供援助和提供庇护的人力以及后勤基础并没有计划。

sentences.en: And there are fears that if Amra collapses, it would hugely worsen what is already a very dire humanitarian situation.
sentences.zh: 人们担心，如果近东救济工程处崩溃，将极大地恶化本已十分严峻的人道主义局势。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I've spoken to Israeli officials and former officials, and they see it as part of a lack of strategic planning on the part of the Israeli government,
sentences.zh: 我曾与以色列官员和前官员交谈过，他们认为这是以色列政府缺乏战略规划的一部分，

sentences.en: which is avoiding very difficult questions about what Israel wants to see in Gaza after the war ebbs.
sentences.zh: 以色列政府一直在回避关于战争消退后以色列希望在加沙看到什么的极其困难的问题。

sentences.en: And for some of them, it's also exactly the wrong thing to be doing at a time when Israel stands accused of genocide.
sentences.zh: 对其中一些人来说，这也是在以色列被指控犯有种族灭绝罪之际绝对不应该做的事情。

sentences.en: And in particular, when the world's highest court, the International Court of Justice in The Hague, has just ordered Israel to prevent genocide,
sentences.zh: 特别是当世界最高法院——海牙的国际法院刚刚命令以色列防止种族灭绝时，

sentences.en: in part by increasing more aid to Gaza.
sentences.zh: 部分方式是通过向加沙增加更多援助。

sentences.en: And on the same day that that order was made, we instead see a number of countries start pulling funding for the biggest aid operation in the Gaza Strip,
sentences.zh: 就在发布该命令的同一天，我们却看到一些国家开始撤回对加沙地带最大援助行动的资金支持，

sentences.en: which raises questions about whether, in fact, we'll see less aid rather than more.
sentences.zh: 这引发了人们的疑问：我们实际上看到的会不会是援助减少而不是增加。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Obviously, the question of aid is most critical to the ongoing struggle of Gazans to simply survive this war.
sentences.zh: 显然，援助问题对于加沙人在这场战争中艰难生存而言是最为关键的。

sentences.en: But for Israel, the idea that the main aid agency in Gaza would be hobbled, and therefore the humanitarian crisis there would get worse, is both a practical problem,
sentences.zh: 但对以色列来说，加沙的主要援助机构陷入瘫痪从而导致那里的危机恶化，既是一个实际问题，

sentences.en: but also a problem for how the world sees Israel in this moment.
sentences.zh: 也是一个关乎世界在此刻如何看待以色列的问题。

sentences.en: Absolutely.
sentences.zh: 绝对是的。

sentences.en: It's a perception problem for Israel.
sentences.zh: 这对以色列来说是一个形象问题。

sentences.en: But it's also a perception problem for many of the Western countries, including the United States, who were the first to pull funding for Umbra as this scandal broke.
sentences.zh: 但对于许多西方国家（包括美国，它们在此丑闻爆发时率先撤回了对近东救济工程处的资助）来说，这也是一个形象问题。

sentences.en: If Israel has a reputation problem as a result of this war, so too does the United States and the Biden administration because of its support for Israel.
sentences.zh: 如果以色列因这场战争而面临声誉问题，美国和拜登政府也因其对以色列的支持而面临同样的问题。

sentences.en: And its own reputation and perceptions of its intentions are also wrapped up in Israel's fate and Gaza's.
sentences.zh: 其自身的声誉以及外界对其意图的看法也与以色列和加沙的命运交织在一起。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's a very tricky situation for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 是的，对美国

sentences.en: and other funders.
sentences.zh: 和其他金主来说，这是一个非常棘手的情况。

sentences.en: On the one hand, they don't want to be perceived as having anything to do with anyone who has anything to do with Hamas.
sentences.zh: 一方面，他们不希望被认为与任何与哈马斯有染的人有任何瓜葛。

sentences.en: On the other hand, they also don't want to be seen as being responsible in any way for this humanitarian crisis, one that will get worse if the one real aid organization goes away.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，他们也不希望在任何程度上被视为对这场人道主义危机负有责任，如果唯一的真正援助机构消失，这场危机将会进一步恶化。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: But we have seen attempts by U.S.
sentences.zh: 但我们看到美国

sentences.en: officials to cast this suspension in a different light.
sentences.zh: 官员试图以另一种视角来解释这次暂停拨款。

sentences.en: We've seen stories come out saying that actually the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们看到有报道称，实际上美国

sentences.en: was not due to send more funding for a while and that the last remaining tranche of the funding it was supposed to provide in this particular funding cycle was minimal
sentences.zh: 本来就有一段时间不打算再发放资金，而且其在这个特定的资助周期中本应提供的最后一笔资金微乎其微，

sentences.en: and that, in essence, the suspension was more of a symbolic move than one that would actually have practical effect on UMRA's budget.
sentences.zh: 从本质上讲，这种暂停更多是一种象征性举措，而不是真正会对近东救济工程处预算产生实际影响的举措。

sentences.en: So kind of trying to walk it back a bit.
sentences.zh: 所以这有点像是在试图自圆其说或有所保留。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: All that said, while the U.S.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，尽管美国

sentences.en: is the main funder or the largest funder of UMRA, the collective effect of all the other suspensions from more than a dozen other countries
sentences.zh: 是近东救济工程处的主要赞助者或最大赞助者，来自其他十几个国家的暂停资助的累积效应

sentences.en: could well be damaging enough to leave UMRA in major trouble.
sentences.zh: 很可能会带来足够的破坏，使近东救济工程处陷入重大困境。

sentences.en: And according to UMRA, it could go out of business, they say, by the end of the month because there are so many other suspensions of funding from other sources.
sentences.zh: 根据近东救济工程处的说法，由于来自其他来源的资金暂停过多，他们说该机构最早可能在月底前难以为继。

sentences.en: So actually, many in Israel, you know, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以实际上，以色列的许多人，你知道的，美国

sentences.en: and countries around the world and most of all Gazans, are aligned in having pretty serious interest in UMRA not collapsing right now.
sentences.zh: 和世界各地的国家，以及最核心的加沙人，在不希望近东救济工程处现在就崩溃这一点上有着相当重大的共同利益。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: And the key words there are right now.
sentences.zh: 其中的关键词是“现在”。

sentences.en: While this war goes on, certainly there is a strange and perhaps surprising alignment of interests, if not motives.
sentences.zh: 只要这场战争还在继续，当然存在着一种奇怪且或许令人惊叹的利益一致，即便动机未必相同。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: In the long term, of course, there remain profound disagreements not only about the future of UMRA, but the future of Gaza and who should govern it, what role should Hamas play,
sentences.zh: 从长远来看，当然仍然存在着深刻的分歧，不仅关于近东救济工程处的未来，还关于加沙的未来以及谁应该统治它、哈马斯应该扮演什么角色、

sentences.en: what role should Israel play, what role should other Palestinian leaders play, and, of course, what role should UMRA play and should it play any role at all.
sentences.zh: 以色列应该扮演什么角色、其他巴勒斯坦领导人应该扮演什么角色，当然，还有近东救济工程处应该扮演什么角色，以及它是否应该发挥任何作用。

sentences.en: Israel wants to see a completely different architecture of aid agencies and aid distribution.
sentences.zh: 以色列希望看到一个完全不同的援助机构和援助分发架构。

sentences.en: Others think it's entirely the wrong time to be discussing revamping the aid system in a territory where more than 80% of people are displaced,
sentences.zh: 其他人则认为，在一个超过80%的人口流离失所、

sentences.en: more than half the buildings are damaged or destroyed, and one in a hundred people has been killed.
sentences.zh: 超过一半的建筑物受损或被毁、百分之一的人口丧生的领土上，讨论重组援助系统完全不是时候。

sentences.en: Patrick, thank you.
sentences.zh: 帕特里克，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thank you, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 谢谢你，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: The Times reports that UNRWA is set to lose at least $65 million by the end of February as funding cuts made by donors begin to kick in.
sentences.zh: 《时报》报道称，随着捐助者削减资金开始生效，联合国近东救济工程处预计将在2月底前损失至少6500万美元。

sentences.en: In all, 18 states or institutions announced suspensions of funding.
sentences.zh: 总共有18个国家或机构宣布暂停资助。

sentences.en: Some, like the United States, had already made scheduled payments, but others, including Finland, Germany, Japan, and Sweden, had not and are now set to miss them.
sentences.zh: 有些国家（如美国）已经按计划进行了拨款，但其他国家（包括芬兰、德国、日本和瑞典）则尚未拨款，现在看来将错过这些款项。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由刚才你们听到其声音的这些人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 访问 nytimes.com/games 开始今天的游戏。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他新闻。

sentences.en: On Monday, a powerful storm pummeled California for a second day, with wind and rain causing flooding, mudslides, and widespread power outages.
sentences.zh: 周一，一场强风暴连续第二天猛烈袭击加利福尼亚州，风雨引发了洪水、泥石流和大规模停电。

sentences.en: The relentless downpour, which began on Sunday morning, dumped a record amount of rain on Los Angeles, making Sunday the 10th wettest day in the history of the city.
sentences.zh: 这场自周日上午开始的无情倾盆大雨给洛杉矶带来了创纪录的降雨量，使周日成为该市历史上雨水第十多的日子。

sentences.en: At least three people died across the state, including from falling trees in Northern California.
sentences.zh: 全州至少有三人死亡，其中包括北加州因树木倒塌而丧生的人。

sentences.en: On Monday afternoon, as the rain continued, officials warned of the potential danger of more flooding and mudslides.
sentences.zh: 周一下午，随着降雨持续，官员们警告称可能存在更多洪水和泥石流的潜在危险。

sentences.zh: 今天的节目由里奇·诺维茨基（Ricky Nowetsky）制作，

sentences.zh: 威尔·里德（Will Reed）和悉尼·哈珀（Sydney Harper）协助制作，穆杰·扎迪（Muj Zady）提供帮助。

sentences.en: It was edited by Paige Cowett, with help from M.J.
sentences.zh: 节目由佩奇·考维特（Paige Cowett）剪辑，M.J.提供协助。

sentences.zh: 戴维斯-林恩。

sentences.zh: 由苏珊·李进行事实核查。

sentences.zh: 包含玛丽安·洛扎诺和阿莉莎·拜图的原创音乐，由克里斯·伍德进行工程制作。

sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由仙境乐队的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰斯维克创作。

sentences.zh: 这就是本期《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔韦尼西。

sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们将为假期招待客人做好准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让您的客人宾至如归的小贴士。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝到断片才去睡觉。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的要求。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？
